description: This file defines the PimReportData class, which implements report data retrieval and normalization for the HRM system's PIM reports. It interacts with report generation services and handles search filter parameters.

classes.name: PimReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for providing report data and metadata for PIM reports, utilizing report generation services and search filter parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the PimReportData object with specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns normalized report data based on current filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, such as total data count.
